descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S10 Nursing Home visit lifecycle with Regenerate, reload and Back (live AI)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T3 Re-completing a note (Regenerate) never creates a second entry. (TFA-92589 AC 3; TFA-92589 2026-10-02 comment)
  • U5 Nursing Home: a same-day revisit appends rather than overwriting the earlier visit's entry (PR #52). (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 AC 5; TFA-92589 2026-10-02 comment)
  • U4 Nursing Home: entries are keyed by visit number and labelled 'Visit N – date'. (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 AC 5)
  • U1 One entry per completed visit, correctly dated, in chronological order, never duplicated. (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 AC 3)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Fixture resident with no course

When Pre-Round Save Note → Generate → Regenerate Note → reload → Pre-Round Save Note again with new text (revisit) → Generate (the button reads 'Regenerate Note') → browser Back, then Forward

Then After Regenerate and after reload there is still one entry, 'Visit 1 – <today>', still carrying the encounter's facts. After the revisit, Visit 1's text is still there, unchanged (not overwritten), and the revisit's facts appear; under Quinn's reading of Q1 as 'Visit 2 – <today>' once beneath it (recorded until Q1 is answered). …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs, scoped to the Visit Timeline: cp-regen and cp-reload contain 'Visit 1 – {day0}' once, an encounter fact, no 'Visit 2 –' (T3: re-completing never adds an entry) and no 'Encounter done'; cp-revisit-done has 'Visit 1 –' once, the revisit's facts and no 'Visit 3 –'; the Visit 2 label, count and order are notJudged (Q1); …

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S10 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-11.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev.
